name: Stars About War
description: See source-linked classifications beside YouTube channels and videos, without leaving the page.
detail: An unofficial extension displaying records from Stars About War. Labels link to the source so you can review its reasoning. Classifications belong to the source; this extension is not an independent fact-checker.
features: Labels across YouTube feeds, search results and channel pages
Local channel matching and scheduled feed updates
Cached fallback data and Ukrainian / Russian localization
note: Published in Chrome Web Store. Store version and availability can change.

name: Alabuga Detector
tag: A label. A source. Your judgement.
description: Recognize YouTube channels listed in the Alabuga advertising database, with links to source material.
detail: A browser extension showing channel-level labels based on gubanovfiles.com. A label refers to the channel record, not necessarily the video you are watching. Review the original evidence before drawing conclusions.
features: Local matching by channel ID, handle or unique name
Background database updates with a cached fallback
Available for Chrome and Firefox
note: Published browser extension. Source records are maintained by gubanovfiles.com.

name: English Memory
tag: Hear it. Save it. Remember it.
description: Turn English from your microphone or PC audio into vocabulary cards with local AI and spaced repetition.
detail: A native Windows application using local Whisper transcription and language-model analysis. Your vocabulary lives in SQLite on your device. Model-generated translations and level labels need human review.
features: Microphone / PC audio capture with explicit start and pause
Local vocabulary, subtitle imports and review scheduling
Windows x64 build verified; 74 default behavior checks passed
note: Windows 11 x64. Requires building from source and downloading models. No installer is hosted here.

name: English B2 Tracker
tag: A plan you can actually follow.
description: A 12-week English study roadmap with daily tasks, vocabulary, an error log and progress stored in your browser.
detail: A local-first study planner built with Next.js and IndexedDB. It organizes practice and records progress; it does not certify B2 proficiency. Export JSON backups before clearing browser data.
features: Daily tasks, weekly reflections and a study calendar
Vocabulary practice, focus timer and error log
Production build, lint and TypeScript checks passed
note: This page introduces the project. It is not a hosted tracker demo. Initial sample entries are examples.

name: TextFlow
description: Reusable text snippets, global hotkeys and a quick-search palette for Windows.
detail: A portable Windows utility for Unicode text snippets, shortcuts and QuickTextPaste imports. Paste requests are serialized; the inserted text remains on the clipboard.
features: Global hotkeys and a searchable snippet palette
Portable JSON storage and Win32 input integration
Nine behavior checks passed on Windows
note: Windows 10/11. Build from source with the .NET 8 SDK.

name: Shorts Studio
description: A local video pipeline for transcription, clip ranking, vertical reframing and subtitles.
detail: A Python backend and React interface for local media processing. Completed pipeline stages can be reused. The frontend build was checked; a full Docker/media processing run was not verified in this portfolio review.
features: Local faster-whisper transcription and scene analysis
Vertical reframing, subtitles and FFmpeg export
Stage persistence and optional publishing connectors
note: In development. External publishing requires configuration and is disabled by default.

name: FlyStream Lab
tag: A virtual fly takes the stage.
description: An experimental 3D virtual streamer with a control room, OBS view and interactive polls.
detail: A React and Three.js prototype combining shared streamer state with a scientific anatomy workbench. Demo mode works without provider credentials. Real KICK integration and external broadcasting remain unverified.
features: Moderated chat, polls and two scored games
Rights-gated local media and video-only vertical WebM export
Local verification documented; clean-install CI currently fails
note: Source prototype, no hosted demo. Node.js type declarations are missing in the clean-install build; dependency correction is required. OBS/RTMP setup is external.

name: Ashen Oath
description: An offline Android habit planner with pixel-art battles, equipment and local save backups.
detail: Mark self-reported habits to earn experience and prepare a hero for three forest opponents. A signed Android 0.7.2 APK and source are public. Release documentation records emulator checks for 0.7.1 and asset/signature checks for 0.7.2; physical-device performance was not profiled.
features: Scheduled habits, rest days and a progress journal
Hero progression, equipment and tactical battles
JSON save export/import; no account required
note: Russian game interface. Android 7.0+, ARM64 / x86_64. APK release available; store approval not verified. No browser game demo. Export saves before replacing a debug build.

name: Drosophila
tag: A pocket pet and a retro arcade.
description: An Android virtual pet and retro arcade with a public APK release.
detail: A virtual-pet project distributed as an Android APK. The public repository contains the game website and promotional materials; the application source remains private. APK availability is verified, but this portfolio review did not install or retest the release.
features: Virtual-pet and retro-arcade modes
Android 0.15.1 APK available from GitHub Releases
Dedicated game page with screenshots and a trailer
note: Public APK and game materials; application source is not included. Store approval and a browser-playable demo are not verified.

name: CareerPilot Local
tag: A local model for your job search.
description: CV-based job discovery with local AI, a private Telegram bot and opt-in application workflows.
detail: A Python public preview extending fikstt2/hh-ai-agent. Searches public job boards and configured ATS/Telegram sources. Supported submissions require explicit configuration; unknown forms, login and missing required facts can need human review. Successful CI does not prove live compatibility with every employer website.
features: CV import and local Ollama inference
Dry-run discovery with sending disabled by default
Private application ledger and supported opt-in form routes
note: Public preview v0.2.0; not a hosted application or universal unattended applicant. Requires local setup and personal credentials. Based on an upstream MIT project.

name: CrimeWeb RSS Collector
description: A scheduled RSS transport with regional queue balancing, bounded retries and aggregate operational reports.
detail: A standalone Node.js collector run by GitHub Actions. A private server supplies authorized due feeds and validates persisted results. The public repository contains transport code, not the CrimeWeb map, database, classifier or geolocation implementation. Recent workflow runs succeeded; they do not independently verify reported events.
features: Interleaved regional feed queues and resumable maintenance requests
Bounded public HTTP fetching with redirect and address checks
Aggregate operational reporting without article bodies
note: Beta integration requiring a compatible private server and scoped credential. No standalone map demo or packaged release. Scheduled runs are best effort; news reports are not verified facts or crime-rate comparisons.

name: Windows Counter
description: A compact Windows desktop counter with keyboard controls and persistent storage.
detail: A focused Tkinter utility with increment, decrement, manual values and always-on-top mode. Atomic writes preserve the current value between sessions.
features: Buttons, arrow keys and manual integer input
Always-on-top mode and reset confirmation
Persistence and malformed-data fallback verified
note: Python 3.10 or newer with Tkinter. Source project; no installer is hosted here.
